name: lightpath/training-portal
description: Interactive multi-course LMS portal (PHP 8.3) with per-learner Docker lab orchestration, multi-format exports, and Qualiopi compliance

suggest.ext-mbstring: Improves UTF-8 string handling performance (pure-PHP fallback included)
suggest.ext-zip: Required for native SCORM ZIP package generation
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Required when using PostgreSQL PDO storage backend
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: Required when using SQLite PDO storage backend
